references.role: QQ Music mark supplied as visual reference

prompt:
Use case: logo-brand. Create one BBK H1 desktop icon for an unofficial QQ Music client.
Reference image 1 is the actual 480x272 factory H1 desktop: match its compact rounded-square icon proportions, particularly the restrained pale gray tile and subtle depth of its top-row clock/notebook. Reference image 2 is the QQ Music mark: use its yellow circular disk and green single note silhouette.
Place a perfectly round yellow disk with one clear green QQ musical-note mark EXACTLY at the geometric center of the square tile, both horizontally and vertically. The yellow disk center must be at canvas (50%,50%) and its diameter approximately 68% of the tile width. No downward displacement. Maintain equal visual margins above and below the yellow disk.
The tile background is clean pearl white to very light neutral silver-gray, with a tiny restrained pale top highlight, softly rounded corners and shallow edge shading like a small original H1 menu icon. The entire tile stays pale neutral gray. Keep the QQ yellow and green saturated and crisp. Readable when reduced to 45x45 pixels. Straight-on view.
NO headphones, NO stripes, NO horizontal lines or bands, NO green tile background, NO texture or pattern, NO circular coin frame, NO extra objects, NO writing. The rounded-square tile fills about 94% of a square canvas with a narrow symmetrical margin. Fully transparent OUTSIDE the tile; absolutely no disconnected specks, white debris, green fringes or external shadow. Output only the single icon.
